Agent Name: **InformationExtraction_Expert**  
Step Number: **8**  
Reason for Mistake: The **InformationExtraction_Expert** incorrectly identified the NCBI link ([https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/assembly/317138](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/assembly/317138)) as the most relevant source for the CanFam3.1 genome assembly files in May 2020. While the CanFam3.1 assembly itself was correctly identified as the relevant version, the expert failed to confirm the actual file download location for this assembly. The task explicitly required providing the link to the relevant files, and the provided link leads to the NCBI assembly page, which is not the repository of the files. The correct link to the files is: `ftp://ftp.broadinstitute.org/distribution/assemblies/mammals/dog/canFam3.1/`, indicating an error in the final result.

This fits the pattern in **Example 1** where the agent prioritized identifying a general link (NCBI assembly page) but did not ensure that it contained the specific files required for the task. The InformationExtraction_Expert failed to explicitly verify that the provided link met all aspects of the task requirements (i.e., providing a link to the necessary files). This error directly led to the wrong solution for the real-world problem.
